ios.desc:
Bevel is the #1 app for improving your health, performance, and longevity, trusted by hundreds of thousands and backed by science.

From sleep and recovery to stress and strength training, Bevel transforms your health data into personalized guidance you can actually use. Whether you're training for something big or just trying to feel better day to day, Bevel helps you move smarter, recover faster, and live longer.

FEATURES

Bevel Intelligence: Your smart health engine. Bevel Intelligence connects the dots across your data to give you instant feedback and personalized recommendations. It suggests when to train, when to rest, and what's helping or hurting your progress.

Recovery Score: Your daily readiness, simplified. Avoid overtraining, prevent injury, and build sustainable habits by seeing how prepared your body is to perform each day.

Sleep Score: Track and understand your sleep with a single number. Bevel analyzes your sleep stages, duration, and interruptions to reveal how well you're resting. A smart alarm wakes you at the optimal moment in your sleep cycle.

Strain Score: Measure how hard your body is working throughout the day. Your Strain Score is personalized based on your sleep and recovery, helping you train at the right intensity without burning out.

Nutrition Score: Log meals via Barcode Scan, Image Search, Recipe Creation, Describe Meal, or search our database of 6 million+ foods. Set calorie, macro, and nutrient goals in one place. Bevel also supports glucose tracking to see how food affects your metabolism.

Stress Score: See how stress shows up in your body with a real-time score. Understand your stress patterns during sleep, workouts, and daily life.

Strength Builder: Train smarter with Bevel's strength trainer. Choose from 700+ exercises, sync workouts between watch and phone, and get real-time feedback on muscular strain. Generate custom plans or log past workouts to track progress.

Energy Bank: Your body's battery. Bevel combines recovery, sleep, strain, and stress into a single metric to show how your energy builds and drains throughout the day.

Biological Age: Discover how old your body really is. Bevel calculates your biological age using key health markers like sleep, activity, resting heart rate, and more. Track how lifestyle changes move the needle and see how your choices affect aging.

Health Records: Bring your medical data into Bevel. Import lab results, bloodwork, and clinical records to get a complete picture of you
